items.title: Doing the Right Thing Is Not a Business Model: Diabetes Device Openness at DTM 2026
items.summary: Should diabetes CGM apps and data be 100% open? In this Diabetes Technology Meeting debate, Shahid N. Shah argues for usable patient access while separating five decisions that need different answers: personal readings, software interfaces, device control, source code and research data.The presentation examines who funds validation, cybersecurity, support and accountability over a product’s lifetime, and how to distinguish legitimate constraints from patient lock-in. It proposes a practical test for restrictions: name the concern, show the evidence and define what would earn a yes. Includes opening remarks and rebuttal slides.Presented at Diabetes Technology Meeting, October 27, 2026.https://shahidshah.com
